    11→
    12→
    13→axios.interceptors.response
    14→    .use(
    15→        response => {
    16→            state.loading_data.update(false)
    17→            responseAlert(response)
    18→            return response;
    19→        },
    20→        error => {
    21→            state.loading_data.update(false)
    22→            responseAlert(error.response)
    23→            throw error
    24→        },
    25→    )
    26→;
    27→
    28→// Request
    29→export const request = options => {
    30→
    31→    const token = localStorage.getItem('token')
    32→
    33→    state.loading_data.update(true)
    34→
    35→    return axios
    36→        .request({
    37→            ...options,
    38→            headers: {
    39→                ...token && { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    40→                ...options.headers,
    41→            },
    42→            ...options.buildURL && buildURL(options.buildURL),
    43→        })
    44→        .then(res => res.data)
    45→        .catch(err => {
    46→
    47→           /*  return err; */
    48→        });
    49→}
    50→
    51→// URL builder
    52→const buildURL = ({key, params}) => {
    53→
    54→    // 
    55→    var url = urls
    56→
    57→    var prefix = ''
    58→
    59→    // Keys
    60→    var keys = key.split('.')
    61→    keys.forEach(item => {
    62→
    63→        // URL existing
    64→        url = { ...url?.[item] }
    65→        if (!url) throw new Error('URL not found')
    66→
    67→        // Prefix concat
    68→        prefix += url.prefix ? `/${url.prefix}` : ''
    69→
    70→        // Children
    71→        url = url.children || url
    72→    });
    73→
    74→    // Prefix
    75→    url.url = `${prefix}/${url.url}`
    76→
    77→    // Params
    78→    let URLSections = url.url.match(/(:[A-Za-z])\w+[?]?/g)
    79→    if (URLSections) {
    80→        URLSections.forEach(paramKey => {
    81→
    82→            let paramKey2 = paramKey.replace(':', '').replace('?', '')
    83→
    84→            let paramValue = params?.[paramKey2] !== undefined ? params?.[paramKey2] : ''
    85→
    86→            url.url = url.url.replace(
    87→                paramKey,
    88→                paramValue,
    89→            )
    90→            .replace('//', '/')
    91→        });
    92→    }
    93→
    94→    return url
    95→}
    96→
    97→// Response alert
    98→const responseAlert = response => {
    99→
   100→    // Status
   101→    const status = response.status
   102→
   103→    // Key
   104→    const key = 
   105→        // Info
   106→        (status >= 100 && status < 200) ? 'info' :
   107→        // Success
   108→        (status >= 200 && status < 300) ? 'success' :
   109→        // Error
   110→        (status >= 400 && status < 600) ? 'error' :
   111→        // Other
   112→        null;
   113→
   114→    // Exit if no alert is needed
   115→    if (response.config.alert !== true && !response.config.alert?.[key]) return
   116→
   117→    // Get message from server or default message
   118→    let title = response.response?.data?.message || response.data?.message
   119→    title = title || (key && i18n.tc(`app_${key}`));
   120→
   121→    // Build alert configuration
   122→    const alertOptions = {
   123→        icon: key,
   124→        title,
   125→         didOpen: (modal) => {
   126→            // El contenedor principal de la alerta es el padre del elemento modal.
   127→            // Le asignamos un z-index alto para que aparezca sobre otros elementos.
   128→            if (modal.parentElement) {
   129→                modal.parentElement.style.zIndex = '9999';
   130→            }
   131→        },
   132→        ...response.config.alert?.[key]
   133→    };
   134→
   135→    // Fire alert using Swal
   136→    Swal.fire(alertOptions);
   137→}
